_comment: Google Gemini — FREE tier, no credit card required. Copy to llm_config.json.
_security: NEVER put a real key in this file. Put it in the environment variable named by api_key_env.
_setup: 1) Get a key at https://aistudio.google.com/apikey (sign in with a Google account; no billing needed). 2) export GEMINI_API_KEY="..." 3) cp llm_config.gemini.json llm_config.json 4) python3 app.py
_thinking_note: Gemini counts hidden thinking tokens against max_tokens. The app adds thinking_headroom on top of each answer's length so replies are not empty.
